sys_remote_update_set.description: Includes a variable set containing a single checkbox. When checked, the associated client script loops through all visible variables on the form and fills them with default values. It recursively re-runs until all dependent (UI policy-controlled) questions are revealed and filled. Reference fields are populated via a GlideAjax call to a Script Include, which returns the first matching record that satisfies any configured reference qualifiers.
sys_remote_update_set.name: Form AutoFiller

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable>IO:9afcfa05c391221086987132b4013159</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>false</isolate_script><messages/><name>Autofill test data</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || !newValue) {
        return;
    }
    fillVisibleFields(0);
}

function fillVisibleFields(attempts) {
    if (attempts > 5) {
        return;
    }

    var changed = false;
    var fields = g_form.getEditableFields() || [];

    for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
        var name = fields[i];
        var ui = g_form.getGlideUIElement(name);

        if (name === 'fill_test_data') {
            continue;
        }

        if (!g_form.isVisible(name)) {
            continue;
        }

        if (!ui) {
            continue;
        }

        var raw = g_form.getValue(name);
        if (raw !== null && raw.trim() !== '') {
            continue;
        }

        var ctrl = g_form.getControl(name);
        if (ctrl && ctrl.tagName === 'SELECT') {
            if (ctrl.options.length > 1) {
                g_form.setValue(name, ctrl.options[1].value);
                changed = true;
            }
            continue;
        }

        switch (ui.type) {
            case 'text':
            case 'textarea':
            case 'string':
                g_form.setValue(name, 'Test value');
                changed = true;
                break;

            case 'choice':
            case 'select_box':
                var sel = g_form.getControl(name);
                if (sel && sel.options.length > 1) {
                    g_form.setValue(name, sel.options[1].value);
                    changed = true;
                }
                break;

            case 'radio':
                var radios = document.getElementsByName(name);
                if (radios && radios.length) {
                    g_form.setValue(name, radios[0].value);
                    changed = true;
                }
                break;

            case 'checkbox':
                g_form.setValue(name, true);
                changed = true;
                break;

            case 'glide_date':
                var d = new Date(),
                    mm = ('0' + (d.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2),
                    dd = ('0' + d.getDate()).slice(-2),
                    ds = d.getFullYear() + '-' + mm + '-' + dd;
                g_form.setValue(name, ds);
                changed = true;
                break;

            case 'glide_date_time':
                var ts = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ');
                g_form.setValue(name, ts);
                changed = true;
                break;

            case 'reference':
                fillReferenceField(name, function(success) {
                    fillVisibleFields(attempts + 1);
                });
                return;
        }
    }

    if (changed) {
        setTimeout(function() {
            fillVisibleFields(attempts + 1);
        }, 300);
    }
}

function fillReferenceField(varName, callback) {
    var ga = new GlideAjax('ReferenceFetcher');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getFirstReference');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_variable', varName);
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer) {
        if (!answer || answer === 'null') {
            if (callback) callback(false);
            return;
        }
        var parts = answer.split('::'),
            sysId = parts[0],
            disp = parts[1] || '';

        g_form.setValue(varName, sysId);

        var dispInput = document.getElementById('sys_display.' + varName);
        if (dispInput) {
            dispInput.value = disp;
            if (typeof dispInput.onchange === 'function') dispInput.onchange();
        }
        if (callback) callback(true);
    });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-05-02 16:18:22</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>49897201c391221086987132b4013137</sys_id><sys_mod_count>39</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Autofill test data</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_49897201c391221086987132b4013137</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-05-03 15:48:20</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set display_value="fill test data">9cc8ba4dc351221086987132b401315d</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
